title: Shifted successor formula for a prefix value
statement: For every Boolean sequence $f:\mathbb{N}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ and natural number $i$, its weighted prefix value below $i+1$ equals $(f(0)) + 2$ times the weighted prefix value below $i$ of the shifted sequence $j\mapsto f(j+1)$, where a true Boolean has value $1$ and a false Boolean has value $0$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean sequence indexed by natural numbers
